current.notes: Found two distinct recurring deals for Virago (M Street's upscale sushi/Asian restaurant in the Gulch, 1120 McGavock St), despite inKind not flagging happy_hour=true. (1) 'Maki-Sake Monday' — a branded, Monday-only, restaurant-wide special (half-price starters, half-price select maki rolls, 2-for-1 sake and cocktails) confirmed directly in the official site's own structured menu data (viragonashville.com runs on the Popmenu platform, which exposes machine-readable menu content) — this is the highest-confidence finding since it comes straight from the venue. (2) A 'Daily Happy Hour' (5-7pm, bar/lounge, $6 cocktails and wine by the glass, plus raw bar/chef's favorites) reported consistently by two independent secondary sources (do615.com and totalhappyhour.com), but never mentioned on the official site itself and contradicted in specifics (days/price/end-time) by a third aggregator (happyhournearmenow.com) — so this is marked medium confidence with the disagreement flagged rather than silently resolved. A fourth aggregator (thehappyhourfinder.com) was discarded outright as stale (wrong pre-relocation address and dead domain). WebFetch was blocked (403) on viragonashville.com, mstreetnashville.com, and yelp.com directly, so the official-site content was retrieved instead via the browser tool by reading the page's embedded schema.org/Popmenu JSON data. Given the venue clearly has at least one real, well-documented recurring deal (Maki-Sake Monday) plus reasonable secondary corroboration for a daily happy hour, verified_no_hh=false is the honest call here — this is the opposite failure mode from the Philippe Chow miss (a real HH inKind didn't flag) but confirms the same lesson: the absence of inKind's flag doesn't mean absence of a deal. disagreements: happyhournearmenow.com says the happy hour runs Mon-Thu 5:00-6:30pm only (none Fri-Sun) at $8 cocktails/$7 wine/$6 sake plus $9 crispy rice tuna, while do615.com and totalhappyhour.com both independently describe a DAILY (7-day) happy hour 5:00-7:00pm at a flat $6 for cocktails and wine by the glass. Kept the do615/totalhappyhour version in windows[] since it has two agreeing independent sources vs. one dissenting source.

thehappyhourfinder.com lists a Mon-Fri 5-7pm happy hour with $5 champagne/cocktails/martinis, but cites Virago's OLD address (1811 Division St) and defunct domain (viragosushi.com) — clearly stale data predating the venue's move to 1120 McGavock St — so it was excluded entirely from windows[].
